name: Ganon Products Ltd
summary: Ganon Products Limited engages in trading and wholesale of various commodities in India and internationally. The company engages in the trading of agro commodities, metal and steel products, thermal coal, and garnet, as well as cotton and fabrics. The company was formerly known as Ganon Trading and Finance Company Limited and changed its name to Ganon Products Limited in February 2018. Ganon Products Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
